title: Member of Technical Staff (Software Engineer, Training Infrastructure)
description_html:
Perplexity is seeking software engineers to join our Training Infrastructure team. We’re responsible for the large-scale RL and agent evaluation platforms that enable Perplexity to train state-of-the-art models and optimize agent harnesses.

We are full-stack engineers with a broad remit. If you join us, you’ll build the distributed systems that orchestrate AI workloads across global-scale compute infrastructure. You’ll also define novel user and agent interfaces for designing, managing, and launching experiments. You’ll create tools that make experiment results legible to humans and agents alike, enabling everything from ad-hoc experiment retrospectives to closed-loop autoresearch. And much more!

A strong candidate will possess both experience and passion for solving difficult problems at the intersection of AI, distributed systems, and research acceleration.




QUALIFICATIONS

 - 2+ years of experience developing and shipping distributed systems for compute-intensive workloads, with a focus on reliability, scalability, and performance.

 - Proficiency in a general-purpose backend language such as Python, Rust, C++, or Go, and experience with cloud infrastructure and container orchestration, such as AWS and Kubernetes.

 - Familiarity with reinforcement learning (RL), agent evaluation, or ML infrastructure, and an interest in building systems that accelerate experimentation and model development.

 - BS, MS, or PhD in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.




WHY PERPLEXITY IS DIFFERENT

 - Craftsmanship. We build high quality, tasteful products targeting both the AI native and AI curious.

 - Ownership. You identify the problem, design the solution and ship it.

 - Entrepreneurship. We think like founders, act with urgency, and hustle to deliver for each other and our users.

 - Scholarship. Work among highly talented peers, pursuing knowledge and truth, upleveling ourselves, our teams, and our products.

 - Partnership. We amplify each others' strengths, break down silos, and give selflessly to help our colleagues deliver excellence.
$220K – $405K • Offers Equity

title: Senior Software Engineer(Distributed Systems)
description_html: Your work days are brighter here.     We’re obsessed with making hard work pay off, for our people, our customers, and the world around us. As a Fortune 500 company and a leading AI platform for managing people, money, and agents, we’re shaping the future of work so teams can reach their potential and focus on what matters most. The minute you join, you’ll feel it. Not just in the products we build, but in how we show up for each other. Our culture is rooted in integrity, empathy, and shared enthusiasm. We’re in this together, tackling big challenges with bold ideas and genuine care. We look for curious minds and courageous collaborators who bring sun-drenched optimism and drive. Whether you're building smarter solutions, supporting customers, or creating a space where everyone belongs, you’ll do meaningful work with Workmates who’ve got your back. In return, we’ll give you the trust to take risks, the tools to grow, the skills to develop and the support of a company invested in you for the long haul. So, if you want to inspire a brighter work day for everyone, including yourself, you’ve found a match in Workday, and we hope to be a match for you too.           About the Team  Data Platform and Observability Engineering builds the platforms Workday teams use to turn data into reliable, governed products. We sit at the intersection of distributed systems, analytics engineering, and platform operations.  This team is building a highly scalable data-product platform: compute, storage, catalog, orchestration, access control, and the workflows teams use to develop, test, and operate data products and marts. We treat the platform as a product, reusable capabilities, clear contracts, and a path from model to query to visualization, so engineering and analytics teams can own what they build without each standing up a stack of their own.  We work closely with domain engineering, analytics, security, and infrastructure partners. The work is hands-on: production SQL and dbt, lakehouse services, Terraform, and the operational bar for high-volume, multi-team use.    About the Role     We are looking for a hands-on Software Development Engineer to build and operate a  scalable data-product platform  that enables engineering and analytics teams to create and govern production data products and marts.  The platform spans the full data-product lifecycle, including  dbt Core, Airflow, Trino, Apache Iceberg, Amazon S3 Tables, AWS Glue Catalog, access control, security, infrastructure as code, and CI/CD .  This role combines  data platform engineering with hands-on data-product development . You will help build the underlying platform and its reusable capabilities, while also creating and maintaining production dbt projects, data models, tests, semantic definitions, and data marts. You will write highly performant analytical SQL, and you will help teams use a visualization layer such as  Apache Superset  or  Metabase .  You will work on problems involving  high-volume data, distributed query processing, data modeling, data quality, platform reliability, governance, security, and developer experience .   What You Will Do   Build and evolve platform capabilities across  dbt, Airflow, Trino, Iceberg/S3 Tables, Glue Catalog, security, and infrastructure .  Create and maintain  production dbt projects  end-to-end, including data models, transformations, tests, documentation, and semantic definitions.  Design and operate  Airflow workflows  with scheduling, dependencies, retries, backfills, and recovery.  Develop and optimize high-volume analytical workloads on  Trino and Iceberg , including partitioning, incremental processing, file layout, and query performance.  Implement  data quality, access control, and security  using governed catalog and IAM patterns.  Use  Terraform and CI/CD  to automate platform and data-product deployment.  Contribute to the  semantic and visualization layer  for data-product consumption.  Troubleshoot and operate the full stack, with a focus on  reliability, scalability, and safe production operations .  Build reusable platform patterns that make it easier for teams to develop and operate data products.  Support and mentor team members on data platform and data-product development      About You      Basic Qualification      Basic Qualifications  8+ years of software engineering or data engineering experience.  5+ years of experience building or operating production  data platforms, lakehouse platforms, or distributed data systems .  Hands-on experience building and maintaining  production dbt Core projects .  Strong production SQL and data-modeling experience.  Experience with  Airflow or another production workflow orchestration platform .  Experience with  Trino or another distributed SQL/query engine .  Experience with a lakehouse technology such as  Apache Iceberg, Delta Lake, or Hudi .  Experience with cloud object storage and metadata/catalog systems.  Experience with Python, Java, Go, Scala, or another production programming language.  Experience with infrastructure as code such as  Terraform .  Experience working with production data access controls and security.  Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience.  Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related discipline; a Master’s in a related field is preferred, or equivalent practical experience.     Other Qualification    Data Platform   Hands-on experience building or operating  multi-team data/lakehouse platforms .  Experience with reusable platform patterns across  project structure, orchestration, catalog, CI/CD, and environments .   dbt & Data Products   Strong  production dbt  experience, including project architecture, macros, packages, tests, and large model graphs.  Experience with  data modeling, marts, data quality, and semantic/metrics definitions  across multiple domains.   Lakehouse & Query Engines   Strong  Trino  experience, including query execution and performance tuning.  Hands-on  Apache Iceberg  experience: partitioning, schema evolution, snapshots, and table maintenance.  Experience with  S3 Tables, Glue Catalog , or comparable lakehouse storage/catalog technologies.  Strong understanding of  query and data-layout optimization  for high-volume workloads.   Visualization   Experience with  Apache Superset, Metabase , or similar BI platforms.   Security, Infrastructure & Operations   Experience with  Terraform, IAM, least privilege, encryption, CI/CD, monitoring, and production operations .  Experience operating reliable, multi-tenant data platforms.   Kafka, Spark, Flink , or similar distributed technologies are a plus. title: Software Engineer - Storage
description_html:
ABOUT SUPABASE

Supabase is the Postgres development platform, built by developers for developers. We provide a complete backend solution including Database, Auth, Storage, Edge Functions, Realtime, and Vector Search. All services are deeply integrated and designed for growth.



ABOUT THE ROLE

Supabase Storage https://supabase.com/docs/guides/storage is a scalable and high performance object storage service and is one of our fastest growing services. The current landscape of tools for uploading, storing, processing and delivering assets is complicated. Developers are forced to think about regions, caching, codecs and security before they can start uploading anything.

We are looking for engineers to solve this problem once and for all!

You will be working across the entire stack - client libraries, CLI, CDN, the storage server and the deployment infrastructure. One day, you might focus on improving upload resilience in iOS applications; the next, you could be optimizing the S3 protocol for efficient retries or finding ways to accelerate upload processing.

You will be contributing to both our open source server https://github.com/supabase/storage and upstream dependencies we use, like the TUS server https://github.com/tus/tus-node-server/pulls?q=sort%3Aupdated-desc+is%3Apr+author%3Afenos+is%3Amerged.

This role is ideal for someone who thrives in async, fast-paced environments and is excited about building developer tools that scale to millions.



WHAT YOU’LL BE RESPONSIBLE FOR

 - Improving our analytics bucket offering and improving the storage of open file formats like iceberg and ducklake

 - Asset optimization to speed up delivery for websites and mobile applications

 - Building out our edge network to speed up uploads and build features like automatic cache invalidation

 - Improve the performance, observability, and reliability of our storage server

 - Work with the frontend team to build a fast, powerful storage explorer

 - Improve our APIs, client libraries and CLI to provide an exceptional end-to-end DX for our users

 - Resolve escalated support issues, while also identifying and resolving systemic issues across the platform
   


YOU MIGHT BE A GOOD FIT IF YOU

 - Have 5+ years backend engineering experience of running Node.js in production

 - Have experience with highly scalable, distributed systems

 - Are comfortable with working across the stack - backend application development, some infrastructure work including deploying, monitoring and scaling the service

 - Posses familiarity with observability tools (OpenTelemetry, Prometheus, Grafana) and performance tuning

 - Have experience with production-grade PostgreSQL usage, including tuning and troubleshooting

 - Demonstrate an ownership mentality: driving projects end-to-end

 - Display empathy towards developer experience
   


NICE-TO-HAVE

 - Prior experience working on developer tools

 - Solid knowledge of cloud infrastructure (AWS, GCP or Azure) and containerization (Docker, Kubernetes)

 - Direct experience designing and operating large file upload/download pipelines at scale

 - Deep, practical CDN integration and optimization knowledge

 - Experience with image and video processing tools (sharp, dssim, ffmpeg), formats and codecs (AVIF, WebM, Brotli) is a plus

 - Experience with the frontend ecosystem (Next.js, React, etc) is a plus


WHAT WE OFFER

 - Fully Remote
   
   We hire globally. We believe you can do your best work from anywhere. There are no Supabase offices, but we provide a WeWork membership or co-working allowance you can use anywhere in the world.

 - ESOP
   
   Every team member receives ESOP (equity ownership) in the company. We want everyone to share in the upside of what we’re building together.

 - Tech Allowance
   
   Use this budget to set up your ideal work environment—laptop, monitor, headphones, or whatever helps you do your best work.

 - Health Benefits
   
   Supabase covers 100% of health insurance for employees and 80% for dependents, wherever you are. Your wellbeing and your family’s health are important to us.

 - Annual Off-Sites
   
   Once a year, the entire company gathers in a new city for a week of connection, collaboration, and fun. It’s a highlight of our year.

 - Flexible Work
   
   We operate asynchronously and trust you to manage your own time. You know what needs to be done and when.

 - Professional Development
   
   Every team member receives an annual education allowance to spend on learning—courses, books, conferences, or anything that supports your growth.
   
   


ABOUT THE TEAM

Supabase was born-remote and open-source-first. We believe our globally distributed team is our secret weapon in building tools developers love.

 - ~400 team members

 - 60+ countries

 - 20+ languages spoken

 - Over $1B raised (including our $500M Series F)

 - 540,000+ community members

We move fast, build in public, and use what we ship. If it’s in your project, we probably use it in ours too. We believe deeply in the open-source ecosystem and strive to support—not replace—existing tools and communities.
